gloss: to shake, to rock, to undermine

definitions.explanation: To cause something to shake or sway physically.

definitions.gloss: to undermine, to destabilize, to threaten
definitions.explanation: To shake the foundations of something figuratively — to threaten the stability of a system, belief, position, or relationship.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}が{建物|たてもの}を{揺|ゆ}るがした。
{強風|きょうふう}が{窓|まど}を{揺|ゆ}るがしている。
examples.english: The strong wind is rattling the windows.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{爆発音|ばくはつおん}が{町|まち}{全体|ぜんたい}を{揺|ゆ}るがした。
examples.english: A large explosion shook the entire town.

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}を{揺|ゆ}るがす{事件|じけん}だ。
examples.english: It is an incident that shakes trust.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{政権|せいけん}の{基盤|きばん}を{揺|ゆ}るがしかねない。
examples.english: This problem could undermine the foundations of the government.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}を{揺|ゆ}るがすような{大|おお}ニュースが{飛|と}び{込|こ}んできた。
examples.english: Huge news that could shake the world came in.

notes:
USAGE:
The transitive counterpart of {揺|ゆ}るぐ (to shake, to be shaken — intransitive). Sense 2 (figurative undermining) is more common than sense 1 in news and written contexts. Often used with {基盤|きばん} (foundations), {信頼|しんらい} (trust), or {体制|たいせい} (system) as the object.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信頼|しんらい}を{揺|ゆ}るがす: to shake trust
- {基盤|きばん}を{揺|ゆ}るがす: to undermine the foundations
- {世界|せかい}を{揺|ゆ}るがす: to shake the world
- {根底|こんてい}から{揺|ゆ}るがす: to shake from the very bottom

RELATED WORDS:
- {揺|ゆ}るぐ: to shake, to waver (intransitive)
- {揺|ゆ}らす: to shake, to swing (transitive, more gentle motion)
- {揺|ゆ}れる: to sway, to shake (intransitive, general)
